ShareThePain

ShareThePain

No credentials have been provided for this assessment. Running NetExec against the target IP shows the host is a domain controller with the name being dc01 and the domain name as hack.smarter:

┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/Labs/ShareThePain]
└─$ nxc smb 10.1.48.70                                    
SMB         10.1.48.70      445    DC01             [*] Windows Server 2022 Build 20348 x64 (name:DC01) (domain:hack.smarter) (signing:True) (SMBv1:None) (Null Auth:True)
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/Labs/ShareThePain]
└─$ nxc smb 10.1.48.70                                    
SMB         10.1.48.70      445    DC01             [*] Windows Server 2022 Build 20348 x64 (name:DC01) (domain:hack.smarter) (signing:True) (SMBv1:None) (Null Auth:True)

I modified my /etc/hosts file and inserted the following entry:

10.1.48.70 dc01.hack.smarter hack.smarter
10.1.48.70 dc01.hack.smarter hack.smarter

As noticed previously in the command output, the domain controller allows null authentication. Using this, I managed to enumerate the shares in the domain controller. Then I identified a share called Share with READ and WRITE privileges:
